विहस्य दक्षं कुपितो वचः प्राह महामुनिः ..
शृण्वतां सर्वदेवानां सर्वज्ञानमयः स्वयम् ..78..
17.9.m: Laughing at Dakṣa, enraged, the great sage spoke words / while all the gods listened, being himself full of all knowledge: 78

17.9.s:
yataḥ pravṛttirviśvātmā yaścāsau bhuvaneśvaraḥ ..
na tvaṃ pūjayase rudraṃ devaiḥ saṃpūjyate haraḥ ..79..
17.9.d:
यतः प्रवृत्तिर्विश्वात्मा यश्चासौ भुवनेश्वरः ..
न त्वं पूजयसे रुद्रं देवैः संपूज्यते हरः ..79..
17.9.m: 'He from whom creation proceeds, the soul of the universe, and who is the ruler of the world— / you do not worship Rudra, [yet] Hara is worshipped by the gods.' 79

17.9.s:
.. dakṣa uvāca .. ..
asthimālādharo nagnaḥ saṃhartā tāmaso haraḥ ..
viṣakaṃṭhaḥ śūlahastaḥ kapālī nāgaveṣṭitaḥ .. 7.2.9.80 ..
17.9.d:
.. दक्ष उवाच .. ..
अस्थिमालाधरो नग्नः संहर्ता तामसो हरः ..
विषकंठः शूलहस्तः कपाली नागवेष्टितः .. 7.2.9.80 ..
17.9.m: Dakṣa said: / 'Wearing a garland of bones, naked, a destroyer, tamasic is Hara, / poison-throated, trident in hand, skull-bearing, wrapped in serpents. 80

17.9.s:
īśvaro hi jagatsraṣṭā prabhuryo'sau sanātanaḥ ..
sattvātmako'sau bhagavānijyate sarvakarmasu .. 81 ..
17.9.d:
ईश्वरो हि जगत्स्रष्टा प्रभुर्योऽसौ सनातनः ..
सत्त्वात्मकोऽसौ भगवानिज्यते सर्वकर्मसु .. 81 ..
17.9.m: The Lord is indeed the creator of the world, the master who is eternal; / he, the lord composed of sattva, is worshipped in all rites.' 81

17.9.s:
.. dadhīciruvāca .. ..
kiṃ tvayā bhagavāneṣa sahasrāṃśurna dṛśyate ..
sarvalokaikasaṃhartā kālātmā parameśvaraḥ .. 82 ..
17.9.d:
.. दधीचिरुवाच .. ..
किं त्वया भगवानेष सहस्रांशुर्न दृश्यते ..
सर्वलोकैकसंहर्ता कालात्मा परमेश्वरः .. 82 ..
17.9.m: Dadhīci said: / 'Is this thousand-rayed Lord not seen by you, / the sole destroyer of all worlds, the soul of Time, the supreme lord? 82

17.9.s:
eṣa rudro mahādevaḥ kaparddī cāgraṇīrharaḥ ..
ādityo bhagavānsūryo nīlagrīvo vilohitaḥ .. 83 .. ..
17.9.d:
एष रुद्रो महादेवः कपर्द्दी चाग्रणीर्हरः ..
आदित्यो भगवान्सूर्यो नीलग्रीवो विलोहितः .. 83 .. ..
17.9.m: This is Rudra, Mahādeva, the matted-haired one, the leader, Hara, / the divine sun Āditya, blue-necked, deep red.' 83

17.9.s:
.. dakṣa uvāca .. ..
ya ete dvādaśādityā āgatā yajñabhāginaḥ ..
sarve sūryā iti jñeyā na hyanyo vidyate raviḥ .. 884 ..
evamukte tu munayaḥ samāyātā didṛkṣavaḥ ..
bāḍhamityabruvandakṣaṃ tasya sāhāyyakāriṇaḥ .. 85 ..
tapasāviṣṭamanaso na paśyaṃti vṛṣadhvajam ..
sahasraśo'tha śataśo bahuśo'tha ya eva hi .. 86 ..
devāṃśca sarve bhāgārthamāgatā vāsavādayaḥ ..
nāpaśyandevamīśānamṛte nārāyaṇaṃ harim .. 87 ..
rudraṃ krodhaparaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmā brahmāsanādyayau ..
antarhite bhagavati dakṣo nārāyaṇaṃ harim .. 88 ..
rakṣakaṃ jagatāṃ devaṃ jagāma śaraṇaṃ svayam ..
pravartayāmāsa ca taṃ yajñaṃ dakṣo'tha nirbhayaḥ .. 89 ..
rakṣako bhagavānviṣṇuḥ śaraṇāgatarakṣakaḥ ..
punaḥ prāhādhvare dakṣaṃ dadhīco bhagavannṛpa .. 7.2.9.90 ..
17.9.d:
.. दक्ष उवाच .. ..
य एते द्वादशादित्या आगता यज्ञभागिनः ..
सर्वे सूर्या इति ज्ञेया न ह्यन्यो विद्यते रविः .. 884 ..
एवमुक्ते तु मुनयः समायाता दिदृक्षवः ..
बाढमित्यब्रुवन्दक्षं तस्य साहाय्यकारिणः .. 85 ..
तपसाविष्टमनसो न पश्यंति वृषध्वजम् ..
सहस्रशोऽथ शतशो बहुशोऽथ य एव हि .. 86 ..
देवांश्च सर्वे भागार्थमागता वासवादयः ..
नापश्यन्देवमीशानमृते नारायणं हरिम् .. 87 ..
रुद्रं क्रोधपरं दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मासनाद्ययौ ..
अन्तर्हिते भगवति दक्षो नारायणं हरिम् .. 88 ..
रक्षकं जगतां देवं जगाम शरणं स्वयम् ..
प्रवर्तयामास च तं यज्ञं दक्षोऽथ निर्भयः .. 89 ..
रक्षको भगवान्विष्णुः शरणागतरक्षकः ..
पुनः प्राहाध्वरे दक्षं दधीचो भगवन्नृप .. 7.2.9.90 ..
17.9.m:
Dakṣa said: / 'These twelve Ādityas who have arrived to receive a share of the sacrifice, / all of them are to be known as suns; indeed there is no other Ravi.' 84
When this was said, the sages who had arrived eager to see / said, 'Indeed,' to Dakṣa, being his helpers. 85
Their minds overpowered by austerity, they did not see the bull-bannered one, / [though they were] in their thousands, their hundreds, and in great numbers. 86
And all the gods, Vāsava and the rest, having arrived for their share, / did not see the god Īśāna, except Nārāyaṇa Hari. 87
Seeing Rudra bent on anger, Brahmā departed from Brahmā's seat; / when the Lord had disappeared, Dakṣa [turned to] Nārāyaṇa Hari. 88
Dakṣa himself went for refuge to the god who is the protector of the worlds, / and then, fearless, set that sacrifice in motion. 89
The protector is the blessed Viṣṇu, protector of those who seek refuge. / Again at the sacrifice the blessed Dadhīca spoke to Dakṣa, O king: 90

17.9.s:
nirbhayaḥ śṛṇu dakṣa tvaṃ yajñabhaṃgo bhavi ṣyati ..
apūjyapūjanāddakṣa pūjyasya ca vivarjanāt .. 91 ..
naraḥ pāpamavāpnoti mahadvai nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
asatāṃ pragraho yatra satāṃ caiva vimānatā .. .. 92 ..
daṇḍo devakṛtastatra sadyaḥ patati dāruṇaḥ ..
evamuktvā sa viprarṣiḥ śaśāpeśvaravidviṣaḥ .. 93 ..
yasmādbahiṣkṛto devo bhavadbhiḥ parameśvaraḥ ..
bhaviṣyadhvaṃ trayībāhyāḥ sarve'pīśvaravidviṣaḥ .. 94 ..
mithyārītisamācārā mithyājñānaprabhāṣiṇaḥ ..
prāpte kaliyuge ghore kalijaiḥ kila pīḍitāḥ .. 95 ..
kṛtvā tapobalaṃ ghoraṃ gacchadhvaṃ narakaṃ punaḥ ..
bhaviṣyati hṛṣīkeśaḥ svāmī vo'pi parāṅmukhaḥ .. 96 ..
.. sārasvata uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā sa brahmarṣirvirarāma taponidhiḥ ..
jagāma manasā rudramaśeṣādhvaranāśanam .. 97 ..
17.9.d:
निर्भयः शृणु दक्ष त्वं यज्ञभंगो भवि ष्यति ..
अपूज्यपूजनाद्दक्ष पूज्यस्य च विवर्जनात् .. 91 ..
नरः पापमवाप्नोति महद्वै नात्र संशयः ..
असतां प्रग्रहो यत्र सतां चैव विमानता .. .. 92 ..
दण्डो देवकृतस्तत्र सद्यः पतति दारुणः ..
एवमुक्त्वा स विप्रर्षिः शशापेश्वरविद्विषः .. 93 ..
यस्माद्बहिष्कृतो देवो भवद्भिः परमेश्वरः ..
भविष्यध्वं त्रयीबाह्याः सर्वेऽपीश्वरविद्विषः .. 94 ..
मिथ्यारीतिसमाचारा मिथ्याज्ञानप्रभाषिणः ..
प्राप्ते कलियुगे घोरे कलिजैः किल पीडिताः .. 95 ..
कृत्वा तपोबलं घोरं गच्छध्वं नरकं पुनः ..
भविष्यति हृषीकेशः स्वामी वोऽपि पराङ्मुखः .. 96 ..
.. सारस्वत उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वा स ब्रह्मर्षिर्विरराम तपोनिधिः ..
जगाम मनसा रुद्रमशेषाध्वरनाशनम् .. 97 ..
17.9.m:
'O fearless Dakṣa, listen! The destruction of the sacrifice will occur, / because of worshipping the unworthy and abandoning the worthy of worship, O Dakṣa. 91
A man incurs great sin indeed; there is no doubt of this. / Where the wicked are favored and the virtuous are treated with contempt, 92
there terrible punishment inflicted by the gods falls instantly.' / Having spoken thus, that brahmin-seer cursed those who hate the Lord: 93
'Since the supreme lord god has been excluded by you, / you shall all become outsiders to the three Vedas, haters of the Lord, 94
following false customs and conduct, proclaiming false knowledge, / afflicted indeed by the evils born of Kali when the terrible Kali age arrives. 95
Having exerted terrible power of austerity, you shall go to hell again, / and Hṛṣīkeśa, your master, will also turn his face away from you.' 96
Sārasvata said: / Having spoken thus, that brahmin-seer, a treasury of austerity, fell silent; / in his mind he approached Rudra, the destroyer of all sacrifices. 97

17.9.s:
etasminnaṃtare devī mahādevaṃ maheśvaram ..
gatvā vijñāpayāmāsa jñātvā dakṣamakhaṃ śivā .. 98 ..
.. devyuvāca .. ..
dakṣo yajñena yajate pitā me pūrvajanmani ..
tena tvaṃ dūṣitaḥ pūrvamahaṃ cātīva duḥkhitā ..
vināśayasva taṃ yajñaṃ varamenaṃ vṛṇomyaham .. 99 ..
.. sārasvata uvāca .. ..
evaṃ vijñāpito devyā devadevo maheśvaraḥ ..
sasarja sahasā rudraṃ dakṣayajñajighāṃsayā .. 7.2.9.100 ..
sahasraśirasaṃ krūraṃ sahasrākṣaṃ mahābhujam ..
sahasrapāṇiṃ durddharṣaṃ yugāṃtānalasannibham .. 101 ..
daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ duṣprekṣyaṃ śaṃkhacakradharaṃ prabhum..
daṇḍahastaṃ mahānādaṃ śārṅgiṇaṃ bhūtibhūṣaṇam .. 102 ..
vīrabhadra iti khyātaṃ devadevasamanvitam ..
sa jātamātro deveśamupatasthe kṛtāṃjaliḥ .. 103 ..
tamāha dakṣasya makhaṃ vināśaya śamastu taṃ ..
vinindya māṃ sa yajate gaṃgādvāre gaṇeśvara .. 104 ..
17.9.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे देवी महादेवं महेश्वरम् ..
गत्वा विज्ञापयामास ज्ञात्वा दक्षमखं शिवा .. 98 ..
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
दक्षो यज्ञेन यजते पिता मे पूर्वजन्मनि ..
तेन त्वं दूषितः पूर्वमहं चातीव दुःखिता ..
विनाशयस्व तं यज्ञं वरमेनं वृणोम्यहम् .. 99 ..
.. सारस्वत उवाच .. ..
एवं विज्ञापितो देव्या देवदेवो महेश्वरः ..
ससर्ज सहसा रुद्रं दक्षयज्ञजिघांसया .. 7.2.9.100 ..
सहस्रशिरसं क्रूरं सहस्राक्षं महाभुजम् ..
सहस्रपाणिं दुर्द्धर्षं युगांतानलसन्निभम् .. 101 ..
दंष्ट्राकरालं दुष्प्रेक्ष्यं शंखचक्रधरं प्रभुम्..
दण्डहस्तं महानादं शार्ङ्गिणं भूतिभूषणम् .. 102 ..
वीरभद्र इति ख्यातं देवदेवसमन्वितम् ..
स जातमात्रो देवेशमुपतस्थे कृतांजलिः .. 103 ..
तमाह दक्षस्य मखं विनाशय शमस्तु तं ..
विनिन्द्य मां स यजते गंगाद्वारे गणेश्वर .. 104 ..
17.9.m:
Meanwhile, the goddess Śivā, learning of Dakṣa's sacrifice, / went and made representation to Mahādeva, the great lord. 98
The Goddess said:
"Dakṣa, who was my father in a previous birth, is performing a sacrifice.
By him you were formerly insulted, and I was made exceedingly sorrowful.
Destroy that sacrifice; this is the boon I choose."
The Sārasvata sage said:
Thus addressed by the Goddess, the god of gods, Maheśvara,
at once created a Rudra with the desire to destroy Dakṣa's sacrifice.
A thousand-headed, fierce one, thousand-eyed and mighty-armed,
thousand-handed, unassailable, resembling the fire at the end of the cosmic age,
dreadful with fangs, terrible to behold, a lord bearing a conch and discus,
holding a staff in his hand, roaring loudly, equipped with a bow, adorned with ashes,
renowned as Vīrabhadra, endowed [with the powers] of the god of gods.
As soon as he was born, he approached the lord of the gods with folded hands.
He said to him: "Destroy Dakṣa's sacrifice, and let there be tranquility for you.
Reviling me, O leader of the gaṇas, he sacrifices at Gaṅgādvāra."

17.9.s:
tato baṃdhapramuktena siṃheneva ca līlayā ..
vīrabhadreṇa dakṣasya nāśārthaṃ roma coddhutam .. 105 ..
romṇā sahasraśo rudrā nisṛṣṭāstena dhīmatā ..
romajā iti vikhyātāstatra sāhāyyakāriṇaḥ .. 106 ..
śūlaśaktigadāhastā daṇḍopalakarāstathā ..
kālāgnirudrasaṃkāśā nādayanto diśo daśa ..107..
sarve vṛṣasamārūḍhāḥ sabhā ryāścātibhīṣaṇāḥ ..
samāśritya gaṇaśreṣṭhaṃ yayurdakṣamakhaṃ prati .. 108 ..
devāṃganāsahasrāḍhyamapsarogītināditam ..
vīṇāveṇuninādāḍhyaṃ vedavādābhi nāditam .. 109 ..
dṛṣṭvā dakṣaṃ samāsīnaṃ devaibrahmarṣibhiḥ saha ..
uvāca sa vṛṣārūḍho dakṣaṃ vīraḥ smayanniva .. 7.2.9.110 ..
vayaṃ hyacaturāḥ sarve śarvasyāmitate jasaḥ ..
bhāgārthalipsayā prāptā bhāgānyaccha tvamīpsitān .. 111 ..
17.9.d:
ततो बंधप्रमुक्तेन सिंहेनेव च लीलया ..
वीरभद्रेण दक्षस्य नाशार्थं रोम चोद्धुतम् .. 105 ..
रोम्णा सहस्रशो रुद्रा निसृष्टास्तेन धीमता ..
रोमजा इति विख्यातास्तत्र साहाय्यकारिणः .. 106 ..
शूलशक्तिगदाहस्ता दण्डोपलकरास्तथा ..
कालाग्निरुद्रसंकाशा नादयन्तो दिशो दश ..107..
सर्वे वृषसमारूढाः सभा र्याश्चातिभीषणाः ..
समाश्रित्य गणश्रेष्ठं ययुर्दक्षमखं प्रति .. 108 ..
देवांगनासहस्राढ्यमप्सरोगीतिनादितम् ..
वीणावेणुनिनादाढ्यं वेदवादाभि नादितम् .. 109 ..
दृष्ट्वा दक्षं समासीनं देवैब्रह्मर्षिभिः सह ..
उवाच स वृषारूढो दक्षं वीरः स्मयन्निव .. 7.2.9.110 ..
वयं ह्यचतुराः सर्वे शर्वस्यामितते जसः ..
भागार्थलिप्सया प्राप्ता भागान्यच्छ त्वमीप्सितान् .. 111 ..
17.9.m:
Then, just like a lion playfully released from bonds,
a hair was plucked out by Vīrabhadra for Dakṣa's destruction.
From that hair, thousands of Rudras were produced by that wise one;
they became renowned as the 'Hair-born', his helpers there,
holding tridents, javelins, and maces in their hands, with staffs and stones in their grasps as well,
resembling the fire of destruction and Rudra, making the ten directions resound.
All mounted upon bulls, accompanied by their wives, exceedingly terrifying,
they took refuge with the foremost of the gaṇa and went toward Dakṣa's sacrifice,
which was filled with thousands of divine women, resounded with the songs of apsarases,
rich with the sounds of lutes and flutes, resounding with the recitations of the Vedas.
Seeing Dakṣa seated together with the gods and brahmin seers,
that hero, mounted upon a bull, said to Dakṣa, as if smiling:
"Indeed, we are all unskilled, [attendants] of Śarva of boundless splendor;
we have come desiring our shares; give us the desired portions.

17.9.s:
bhāgo bhavadbhyo deyastu nāsmabhyamiti kathyatām ..
tato vayaṃ viniścitya kariṣyāmo yathocitam .. 112 ..
evamuktā gaṇeśena prajāpatipuraḥsarāḥ .. 113 ..
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
pramāṇaṃ no vijānītha bhāgaṃ maṃtrā iti dhuvam.. 114 ..
.. maṃtrā ūcuḥ .. ..
surā yūyaṃ tamobhūtāstamopahatacetasaḥ ..
ye nādhvarasya rājānaṃ pūjayeyurmaheśvaram .. 115 ..
īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvadevatanurharaḥ ..
.. gaṇa uvāca .. ..
pūjyate sarvayajñeṣu kathaṃ dakṣo na pūjayet..116..
maṃtrāḥ pramāṇaṃ na kṛtā yuṣmābhirbalagarvitaiḥ ..
yasmādasahyaṃ tasmānno nāśayāmyadya garvitam ..117..
ityuktvā yajñaśālāṃ tāṃ devo'hangaṇapuṃgavaḥ ..
gaṇeśvarāśca saṃkruddhā yūpānutpāṭya cikṣipuḥ..118..
prastotāraṃ sahotāramadhvaryuṃ ca gaṇeśvaraḥ ..
gṛhītvā bhīṣaṇāḥ sarve gaṃgāsrotasi cikṣipuḥ ..119..
17.9.d:
भागो भवद्भ्यो देयस्तु नास्मभ्यमिति कथ्यताम् ..
ततो वयं विनिश्चित्य करिष्यामो यथोचितम् .. 112 ..
एवमुक्ता गणेशेन प्रजापतिपुरःसराः .. 113 ..
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
प्रमाणं नो विजानीथ भागं मंत्रा इति धुवम्.. 114 ..
.. मंत्रा ऊचुः .. ..
सुरा यूयं तमोभूतास्तमोपहतचेतसः ..
ये नाध्वरस्य राजानं पूजयेयुर्महेश्वरम् .. 115 ..
ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां सर्वदेवतनुर्हरः ..
.. गण उवाच .. ..
पूज्यते सर्वयज्ञेषु कथं दक्षो न पूजयेत्..116..
मंत्राः प्रमाणं न कृता युष्माभिर्बलगर्वितैः ..
यस्मादसह्यं तस्मान्नो नाशयाम्यद्य गर्वितम् ..117..
इत्युक्त्वा यज्ञशालां तां देवोऽहन्गणपुंगवः ..
गणेश्वराश्च संक्रुद्धा यूपानुत्पाट्य चिक्षिपुः..118..
प्रस्तोतारं सहोतारमध्वर्युं च गणेश्वरः ..
गृहीत्वा भीषणाः सर्वे गंगास्रोतसि चिक्षिपुः ..119..
17.9.m:
Let it be said: 'A share is to be given to you,' or 'Not to us.'
Then, having decided, we will act appropriately."
Thus addressed by the leader of the gaṇas, [the gods] headed by Prajāpati [replied]:
The gods said:
"Know that the mantras are surely our authority regarding the share."
The mantras said:
"O gods, you have become filled with darkness, your minds struck down by darkness,
you who do not worship Maheśvara, the king of the sacrifice!"
"Hara is the Īśvara of all beings, having the body of all the gods."
The gaṇa said:
"He is worshipped in all sacrifices; how could Dakṣa not worship him?
The mantras have not been regarded as authoritative by you who are proud of your strength;
since this is unbearable to us, today I will destroy that arrogant one!"
Having spoken thus, that god, the foremost of the gaṇas, struck the sacrificial hall,
and the enraged leaders of the gaṇas, having uprooted the sacrificial posts, hurled them away.
The leaders of the gaṇas, all terrifying, seized the prastotṛ,
together with the hotṛ and the adhvaryu, and threw them into the stream of the Gaṅgā.

17.9.s:
vīrabhadro'pi dīptātmā vajrayuktaṃ karaṃ hareḥ..
vyaṣṭaṃbhayadadīnātmā tathānyeṣāṃ divaukasām .. 7.2.9.120 ..
bhaganetre tathotpāṭya karāgreṇaiva līlayā ..
nihatya muṣṭinā daṃḍaiḥ saptāśvaṃ ca nyapātayat .. 121 ..
tathā caṃdramasaṃ devaṃ pādāṃguṣṭhena līlayā ..
dharṣayāmāsa valavānsmayamāno gaṇeśvaraḥ .. 122 ..
vahnerhastadvayaṃ chittvā jihvāmutpāṭya līlayā ..
jaghāna mūrdhni pādena munīnapi munīśvarān .. 123 ..
tathā viṣṇuṃ sagaruḍaṃ samāyātaṃ mahābalaḥ ..
vivyādha niśitairbāṇaiḥ staṃbhayitvā sudarśanam .. 124 ..
tataḥ sahasraśo bhadraḥ sasarja garuḍānbahūn ..
vainateyādabhyadhikāngaruḍaṃ te pradudruvuḥ .. 125 ..
tāndṛṣṭvā garuḍo dhīmānpalāyanaparo'bhavat ..
tatsthito mādhavo vegādyathā gauḥ siṃhapīḍitā .. 126 ..
17.9.d:
वीरभद्रोऽपि दीप्तात्मा वज्रयुक्तं करं हरेः..
व्यष्टंभयददीनात्मा तथान्येषां दिवौकसाम् .. 7.2.9.120 ..
भगनेत्रे तथोत्पाट्य कराग्रेणैव लीलया ..
निहत्य मुष्टिना दंडैः सप्ताश्वं च न्यपातयत् .. 121 ..
तथा चंद्रमसं देवं पादांगुष्ठेन लीलया ..
धर्षयामास वलवान्स्मयमानो गणेश्वरः .. 122 ..
वह्नेर्हस्तद्वयं छित्त्वा जिह्वामुत्पाट्य लीलया ..
जघान मूर्ध्नि पादेन मुनीनपि मुनीश्वरान् .. 123 ..
तथा विष्णुं सगरुडं समायातं महाबलः ..
विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैः स्तंभयित्वा सुदर्शनम् .. 124 ..
ततः सहस्रशो भद्रः ससर्ज गरुडान्बहून् ..
वैनतेयादभ्यधिकान्गरुडं ते प्रदुद्रुवुः .. 125 ..
तान्दृष्ट्वा गरुडो धीमान्पलायनपरोऽभवत् ..
तत्स्थितो माधवो वेगाद्यथा गौः सिंहपीडिता .. 126 ..
17.9.m:
Vīrabhadra too, radiant of soul and undefeated in spirit, paralyzed the hand of Hari
which held the thunderbolt, and likewise [the hands] of the other gods.
Likewise, playfully plucking out Bhaga's eyes with the tips of his fingers,
and striking with his fist and with clubs, he brought down the Sun.
Likewise, the powerful leader of the gaṇas, smiling,
playfully crushed the moon god with the big toe of his foot.
Having cut off Agni's two hands and playfully plucked out his tongue,
he struck the sages and foremost seers on the head with his foot.
Likewise, when Viṣṇu arrived along with Garuḍa, the exceedingly mighty one
paralyzed the Sudarśana [discus] and pierced [Viṣṇu] with sharp arrows.
Then Bhadra created thousands of numerous Garuḍas,
greater than the son of Vinatā; they rushed against Garuḍa.
Seeing them, the wise Garuḍa became bent on flight;
Mādhava, seated on him, [fled] with speed, like a cow tormented by a lion.

17.9.s:
aṃtarhite vainateye viṣṇau ca padmasaṃbhavaḥ ..
āgatya vārayāmāsa vīrabhadraṃ śivapriyam .. 127 ..
prasādayāmāsa sa taṃ gauravātparameṣṭhinaḥ ..
te'dṛśyaṃ naiva jānaṃti rudraṃ tatrāgataṃ surāḥ .. 128 ..
sa devo viṣṇunā jñāto brahmaṇā ca dadhīcinā ..
tuṣṭāva bhagavānbrahmā dakṣo viṣṇudivaukasaḥ.. 129 ..
viśeṣātpārvatīṃ devīmīśvarārddhaśarīriṇīm ..
stotrairnānāvidhairdakṣaḥ praṇamya ca kṛtāñjaliḥ .. 7.2.9.130 ..
tato bhagavatī prāha prahasaṃtī maheśvaram ..
tvameva jagataḥ sraṣṭā saṃhartā caiva rakṣakaḥ .. 131 ..
anugrāhyo bhagavatā dakṣaścāpi divau kasaḥ ..
tataḥ prahasya bhagavānkarpaddī nīlalohitaḥ ..
uvāca praṇatāndevāndakṣaṃ prācetasaṃ haraḥ ..132..
gacchadhvaṃ devatāḥ sarvāḥ prasanno bhavatāmaham ..
saṃpūjyaḥ sarvayajñeṣu prathamaṃ devakarmaṇi .. 133 ..
17.9.d:
अंतर्हिते वैनतेये विष्णौ च पद्मसंभवः ..
आगत्य वारयामास वीरभद्रं शिवप्रियम् .. 127 ..
प्रसादयामास स तं गौरवात्परमेष्ठिनः ..
तेऽदृश्यं नैव जानंति रुद्रं तत्रागतं सुराः .. 128 ..
स देवो विष्णुना ज्ञातो ब्रह्मणा च दधीचिना ..
तुष्टाव भगवान्ब्रह्मा दक्षो विष्णुदिवौकसः.. 129 ..
विशेषात्पार्वतीं देवीमीश्वरार्द्धशरीरिणीम् ..
स्तोत्रैर्नानाविधैर्दक्षः प्रणम्य च कृताञ्जलिः .. 7.2.9.130 ..
ततो भगवती प्राह प्रहसंती महेश्वरम् ..
त्वमेव जगतः स्रष्टा संहर्ता चैव रक्षकः .. 131 ..
अनुग्राह्यो भगवता दक्षश्चापि दिवौ कसः ..
ततः प्रहस्य भगवान्कर्पद्दी नीललोहितः ..
उवाच प्रणतान्देवान्दक्षं प्राचेतसं हरः ..132..
गच्छध्वं देवताः सर्वाः प्रसन्नो भवतामहम् ..
संपूज्यः सर्वयज्ञेषु प्रथमं देवकर्मणि .. 133 ..
17.9.m:
When the son of Vinatā and Viṣṇu had disappeared, the lotus-born [Brahmā],
having arrived, restrained Vīrabhadra, who is dear to Śiva.
Out of respect for the Supreme Lord, he propitiated him.
Those gods did not at all see or know that Rudra had arrived there.
That god was recognized by Viṣṇu, by Brahmā, and by Dadhīci.
The lord Brahmā, Dakṣa, Viṣṇu, and the celestials praised [him],
especially [praising] the goddess Pārvatī, who forms half of Īśvara's body;
and Dakṣa, bowing down with folded hands, [praised her] with various hymns.
Then the goddess, laughing gently, said to Maheśvara:
"You alone are the creator of the world, its destroyer, and its protector.
Dakṣa and the gods ought to be shown grace by the Lord."
Then the lord, the matted-haired, blue-and-red Hara, laughing gently,
said to the bowed gods and to Dakṣa, the son of Pracetas:
"Depart, all you deities! I am pleased with you.
I must be worshipped first in all sacrifices and divine rites.

17.9.s:
tvaṃ cāpi śṛṇu me dakṣa vacanaṃ sarvarakṣaṇam ..
tyaktvā lokeṣaṇāmenāṃ madbhakto bhava yatnataḥ .. 134 ..
bhaviṣyasi gaṇeśānaḥ kalpāṃte'nugrahānmama ..
tāvattiṣṭha mamādeśātsvādhikāreṣu nirvṛtaḥ ..
ityuktvā'darśanaṃ prāpto dakṣasyāmitatejasaḥ .. 135 ..
dadhīcinā śivo dṛṣṭo vijñaptaḥ śāpamocane ..
kathaṃ śāpaṃ mayā dattaṃ tariṣyaṃti tavājñayā .. 136 ..
.. śiva uvāca .. ..
bhaviṣyaṃti trayī bāhyāḥ saṃprāpte tu kalau yuge ..

17.9.d:

17.9.m:
And you too, O Dakṣa, listen to my words that protect everything:
Abandoning this desire for worldly things, strive to become my devotee.
At the end of the cosmic age, by my grace, you will become a lord of the gaṇas.
Until then, remain content in your duties by my command."
Having spoken thus to Dakṣa of boundless splendor, he became invisible.
Śiva was seen by Dadhīci and was petitioned concerning release from the curse:
"How shall they, by your command, overcome the curse given by me?"
Śiva said:
"When the Kali age arrives, there will be those outside the three Vedas;
and those brahmins who recite the Vedas shall go to heaven.
The scriptures composed by Viṣṇu that are recited by the twice-born—
they too shall go to heaven by my grace, without doubt.
Those who, by the power of the Kali age, have no Vedic recitation
must practice the duties of a householder and perform my worship.
I must certainly effect their release from sins.
Smeared with ashes, I wander for alms when midday has passed."

17.9.d:
जटाजूटधरः शांतो भिक्षापात्रकरो द्विजः ..

उपानहौ वा च्छत्रं वा कौपीनं वा कमंडलुम् ..
यो ददाति तपस्विभ्यो नरो मुक्तः स पातकैः ..
दधीचेः स वरान्दत्त्वा वभाषे सह विष्णुना .. 142 ..
.. रुद्र उवाच .. ..
यस्ते मित्रं स मे मित्रं यस्ते रिपुः स मे रिपुः ..
यस्त्वां पूजयते विष्णो स मां पूजयते ध्रुवम् .. 143 ..

.. कृष्ण उवाच .. ..

अर्द्धनारीनरवपुर्यदा दृष्टो मया पुरा .. 145 ..

शंखचक्रगदाहस्तं वनमालाविभूषितम् .. 146 ..
17.9.m:
wearing matted hair, tranquil, holding an alms-bowl, a twice-born.
And whoever gives me alms, that human being goes to heaven.
Or shoes, or an umbrella, or a loincloth, or a water-pot—
whatever man gives [these] to ascetics is freed from sins.
Having granted boons to Dadhīci, he spoke with Viṣṇu:
Rudra said:
“He who is your friend is my friend; he who is your enemy is my enemy.
He who worships you, O Viṣṇu, certainly worships me.
He who praises you praises me; he who is dear to you is dear to me.
Where I am, there you are; there is no difference between us.”
Kṛṣṇa said:
“So it is, O supreme God! What should be said is indeed so.
When the form of half-woman and half-man was seen by me long ago,
this was not seen by me as a woman; indeed, my own form was seen,
holding the conch, discus, and mace, adorned with a garland of forest flowers,

न मां गौरी प्रपश्येत प्रपश्यामि तथैव च .. 148 ..
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..

17.9.m:
marked with the Śrīvatsa, clothed in yellow, gleaming with the Kaustubha jewel.
The second half was seen by me holding a trident, having three eyes,
joined with the crescent moon, wearing matted hair and carrying a skull.
I have attained oneness [with you], as formerly, so now;
Gaurī may not see me [as distinct], and likewise I see [her].”
Īśvara said:
“There is no difference between us two; indeed, we both have one form.
He who knows, knows; he goes to Satyaloka.”
Having spoken thus, he went there to Kailāsa, the best of mountains.
And Kṛṣṇa went to Mandara on some business of the gods.
Meanwhile, by the grace of Mahādeva, the king of the Daityas,
the son of Hiraṇyanetra, began to torment the three worlds.
Having obtained immortality from Hara, blinded by desire, he did not see [rightly]:
the goddess who constitutes Hara’s body, of divine form and beautiful eyes,
he thought, ‘She is mine,’ and begged [for her] from Hara.
Hara too, intent on his duty, left Mount Kailāsa

17.9.m:
and reached Mandara to see god Janārdana.
Having consulted with one another, he left the goddess on Mandara.
In Nārāyaṇa’s house, the goddess stayed, surrounded by the retinue of goddesses.
In the meantime, Gautama had become defiled by cow-slaughter;
in order to purify him, Hara assumed the form of a mendicant
and went to Gautama’s house, while Andhaka went to Mandara.
The wicked one demanded Pārvatī and fought with Viṣṇu.
Defeated by all the attendants, the Daitya did not see the goddess.
Assuming the form of a woman, Kṛṣṇa protected Gaurī in the palace.
There Hari created a hundred Gaurīs by his magical power;
excellent women of divine form arose from Viṣṇu’s body.
Andhaka did not know at all: ‘Which one is Gaurī, which is Pārvatī?’
A delay occurred there, as he was bewildered by Viṣṇu’s māyā.
Meanwhile, Śiva returned, having purified Gautama.

17.9.m:
By the mere alms of food, Gautama was rendered immaculate.
Enraged, Rudra then fought with Andhaka.
Though immortal by Hara’s boon, he was impaled on a dreadful trident;
and positioned on the trident, he uttered praise, and Maheśvara was pleased with him.
He gave him the status of Gaṇeśa until the dissolution of all beings.
Kṛṣṇa himself gave him goddess Umā in the form of his sister.
The other women in the form of Gaurī were sent to the earth:
‘Having assumed names for all, you will be worshipped in the world.
Those who will worship them will worship Śivā;
those who worship Śivā worship Hara and Hari.’
Taking Umā, Hara went to the mountain, having mounted the bull, worshipped by gods and Asuras;
and Hari took delight with Ramā, while Andhaka having been subdued, the gods approached the king of gods.
Those who listen to the wondrous life of the high-souled Brahmā, Īśa, and Nārāyaṇa, of virtuous mind,
are freed from sins born of the Kali age, and will go to heaven, praised by host of attendants.

मर्त्यानां केन दानेन तपसा नियमेन वा .. 174 ..
17.9.m:
As time passed in this manner, Hara was on Mount Kailāsa;
and many boons were obtained from him by Rākṣasas, Dānavas, and Daityas.
There was a fierce great Asura named Tāraka who had received a boon from Brahmā;
by him the entire world was pervaded, and the gods were routed by him in battle.
He was to be killed in battle by a son of Mahādeva, so he brought forth him:
Kārtikeya, the son of Umā, born from the semen of Rudra.
He was consecrated as commander of the army by all the gods led by Indra;
and by divine destiny, the one named Tāraka was struck down by him.
Seated on the peak of Kailāsa, the God of gods, the teacher of the world,
content with Umā, was surrounded by Nandin, Bhadra, and others,
joined with Skanda, the Elephant-faced, and the lord of wealth [Kubera].
Then, to the laughing God, Śivā spoke softly:
“By what means, O God, do you attain satisfaction, O Śaṃkara?
By what gift, austerity, or observance of mortals?

17.9.s:
kena vā karmaṇā deva kena mantreṇa vā punaḥ ..
snānena kena deveśa kena dhūpena tuṣyasi .. 175 ..
puṣpeṇa kena me nātha kena patreṇa śaṃkara ..
kayā saṃtuṣyase stutyā sāhasena ca kena vai .. 176 ..
naivedyena ca kena tvaṃ kena homena tuṣyasi ..
kena kaṣṭena vā deva kenārgheṇa mama prabho .. 177 ..
ṣoḍaśaite mayā praśnāḥ pṛṣṭā me nirṇayaṃ vada .. 178 ..
.. śaṃkara uvāca .. ..
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā devi kathayiṣye mama priyam ..
śivapūjāprakāro'yaṃ kriyate vacasā guroḥ ..179..
abhayaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ dānaṃ devi mama priyam ..
satyaṃ tapaḥ samākhyātaṃ paradāravivarjanam .. 7.2.9.180 ..
priyo me niyamo devi karma tallokarañjanam ..
mayoṃ namaḥ śivāyeti mantro'yamurarīkṛtaḥ .. 181 ..
sarvapāpavinirmukto mama devi sa vallabhaḥ ..
pāpatyāgo bhavetsnānaṃ dhūpo me gauggulaḥ priyaḥ .. .. 182 ..
17.9.d:
केन वा कर्मणा देव केन मन्त्रेण वा पुनः ..
स्नानेन केन देवेश केन धूपेन तुष्यसि .. 175 ..
पुष्पेण केन मे नाथ केन पत्रेण शंकर ..
कया संतुष्यसे स्तुत्या साहसेन च केन वै .. 176 ..
नैवेद्येन च केन त्वं केन होमेन तुष्यसि ..
केन कष्टेन वा देव केनार्घेण मम प्रभो .. 177 ..
षोडशैते मया प्रश्नाः पृष्टा मे निर्णयं वद .. 178 ..
.. शंकर उवाच .. ..
साधु पृष्टं त्वया देवि कथयिष्ये मम प्रियम् ..
शिवपूजाप्रकारोऽयं क्रियते वचसा गुरोः ..179..
अभयं सर्वजंतूनां दानं देवि मम प्रियम् ..
सत्यं तपः समाख्यातं परदारविवर्जनम् .. 7.2.9.180 ..
प्रियो मे नियमो देवि कर्म तल्लोकरञ्जनम् ..
मयों नमः शिवायेति मन्त्रोऽयमुररीकृतः .. 181 ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो मम देवि स वल्लभः ..
पापत्यागो भवेत्स्नानं धूपो मे गौग्गुलः प्रियः .. .. 182 ..
17.9.m:
Or by what rite, O God, or again by what mantra?
By what ritual ablution, O Lord of gods, by what incense are you pleased?
By what flower, my lord, by what leaf, O Śaṃkara?
With what hymn of praise are you satisfied, and indeed by what bold deed?
And with what food offering, with what fire offering are you pleased?
By what hardship, O God, by what water-offering [are you pleased], my Lord?
These sixteen questions have been asked by me; tell me the resolution.”
Śaṃkara said:
“Well asked by you, O goddess! I will tell what is dear to me.
This method of Śiva’s worship is performed according to the word of the guru.
Freedom from fear for all living creatures is the gift dear to me, O goddess.
Truth is declared as austerity, along with abstention from another’s wife.
The observance dear to me, O goddess, is action that brings delight to the world.
This mantra, ‘Oṃ, homage to Śiva’, has been embraced by me.
Freed from all sin, he is dear to me, O goddess.
Renunciation of sin is the ritual ablution; incense of bdellium is dear to me.”

17.9.s:
dhattūrakasya puṣpaṃ me bilvapatraṃ mama priyam ..
stutiḥ śivaśivāyeti sāhasaṃ raṇakarmaṇi .. 183 ..
na bibheti naro yastu tasyāgre saṃbhavāmyaham ..
haṃtakāro gavāṃ yastu naivedyaṃ mama vallabham .. 184 ..
pūrṇāhutyā parā prītirjāyate mama sundari..
śuśrūṣā vallabhaṃ kaṣṭaṃ yatīnāṃ ca tapasvinām .. 185 ..
sūryodaye mahādevi madhyāhne'stamane tathā ..
argho yo dīyate sūrye vallabho'sau mama priye .. 186 ..
kiṃ dānaiḥ kiṃ tapobhirvā kiṃ yajñairbhāvavarjitaiḥ..
dayā satyaṃ ghṛṇā'steyaṃ daṃbhapaiśunyavarjitam..
bhaktyā yaddīyate stokaṃ devi tadvallabhaṃ mama.. 187..
evaṃ yāvatkathayati praśnānsūkṣmānyathoditān ..
tāvadbrahmādibhirdevairviṣṇustatra yayau svayam .. 188 ..
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
nāhaṃ pālayituṃ śaktastvaṃ dadāsi varānbahūn ..
daityānāṃ dānavādīnāṃ rākṣasānāṃ maheśvara .. 189 ..
17.9.d:
धत्तूरकस्य पुष्पं मे बिल्वपत्रं मम प्रियम् ..
स्तुतिः शिवशिवायेति साहसं रणकर्मणि .. 183 ..
न बिभेति नरो यस्तु तस्याग्रे संभवाम्यहम् ..
हंतकारो गवां यस्तु नैवेद्यं मम वल्लभम् .. 184 ..
पूर्णाहुत्या परा प्रीतिर्जायते मम सुन्दरि..
शुश्रूषा वल्लभं कष्टं यतीनां च तपस्विनाम् .. 185 ..
सूर्योदये महादेवि मध्याह्नेऽस्तमने तथा ..
अर्घो यो दीयते सूर्ये वल्लभोऽसौ मम प्रिये .. 186 ..
किं दानैः किं तपोभिर्वा किं यज्ञैर्भाववर्जितैः..
दया सत्यं घृणाऽस्तेयं दंभपैशुन्यवर्जितम्..
भक्त्या यद्दीयते स्तोकं देवि तद्वल्लभं मम.. 187..
एवं यावत्कथयति प्रश्नान्सूक्ष्मान्यथोदितान् ..
तावद्ब्रह्मादिभिर्देवैर्विष्णुस्तत्र ययौ स्वयम् .. 188 ..
.. विष्णुरुवाच .. ..
नाहं पालयितुं शक्तस्त्वं ददासि वरान्बहून् ..
दैत्यानां दानवादीनां राक्षसानां महेश्वर .. 189 ..
17.9.m:
The dhattūra flower is dear to me; the bilva leaf is dear to me;
the praise saying 'Śiva, Śiva,' and courage in the act of battle. // 183
Before that man who does not fear, I appear.
A grass-morsel given to cows, as an offering of food, is dear to me. // 184
Through the final oblation, my supreme delight arises, O beautiful woman;
service is dear [to me], and the hardship of ascetics and performers of tapas. // 185
At sunrise, O great goddess, at midday, and likewise at sunset,
the water offering that is given to the sun is dear to me, O beloved. // 186
What use are gifts, what use are austerities, or what use are sacrifices devoid of devotion?
Compassion, truth, tenderness, non-stealing, free from deceit and slander—
whatever little is given with devotion, O goddess, that is dear to me. // 187
While he was thus explaining the subtle questions as uttered,
just then Viṣṇu came there himself, along with the gods headed by Brahmā. // 188
Viṣṇu said:
I am not able to protect [the world]; you grant many boons
to daityas, dānavas, and others, and to rākṣasas, O Maheśvara. // 189

17.9.s:
vikṛtiṃ yāṃti paścātte kaṣṭaṃ vadhyā bhavaṃti me ..
patreṇa puṣpamātreṇa oṃkāreṇa śivena ca ..
muktiṃ yāti naro deva bhavabhaktiṃ karotu kaḥ .. 7.2.9.190 ..
indrādayo'pi ye devā yajñairāpyāyayaṃti te ..
na yajaṃti dvijā yajñānbhikṣādānena tuṣyasi .. 191 ..
.. rudra uvāca .. ..
indrādibhirna me kāryaṃ brahmā me kiṃ kariṣyati ..
yena kena prakāreṇa prajāḥ pālyāstvayā 'dhunā .. 192 ..
madīyā prakṛtistveṣā tāṃ kathaṃ tyaktumutsahe ..
tvayāhaṃ brahmaṇā devairvarakarmaṇi yojitaḥ .. 193 ..
idānīmeva kiṃ naṣṭaṃ muktvā devīṃ tavāgrataḥ ..
bhūtvā mūrtiṃ parityajya ekākī vicarāmyaham .. 194 ..
ityuktvā sa śivo devastatraivāṃtaradhīyata ..
gate tasmiñchive tatra saṃkṣobhaḥ sumahānabhūt .. 195 ..
umā provāca cendrādīnbrahmaviṣṇugaṇāṃstathā ..
idānīṃ kiṃ mayā kāryaṃ bhavadbhiḥ śivavarjitaiḥ .. 196 ..
17.9.d:
विकृतिं यांति पश्चात्ते कष्टं वध्या भवंति मे ..
पत्रेण पुष्पमात्रेण ओंकारेण शिवेन च ..
मुक्तिं याति नरो देव भवभक्तिं करोतु कः .. 7.2.9.190 ..
इन्द्रादयोऽपि ये देवा यज्ञैराप्याययंति ते ..
न यजंति द्विजा यज्ञान्भिक्षादानेन तुष्यसि .. 191 ..
.. रुद्र उवाच .. ..
इन्द्रादिभिर्न मे कार्यं ब्रह्मा मे किं करिष्यति ..
येन केन प्रकारेण प्रजाः पाल्यास्त्वया ऽधुना .. 192 ..
मदीया प्रकृतिस्त्वेषा तां कथं त्यक्तुमुत्सहे ..
त्वयाहं ब्रह्मणा देवैर्वरकर्मणि योजितः .. 193 ..
इदानीमेव किं नष्टं मुक्त्वा देवीं तवाग्रतः ..
भूत्वा मूर्तिं परित्यज्य एकाकी विचराम्यहम् .. 194 ..
इत्युक्त्वा स शिवो देवस्तत्रैवांतरधीयत ..
गते तस्मिञ्छिवे तत्र संक्षोभः सुमहानभूत् .. 195 ..
उमा प्रोवाच चेन्द्रादीन्ब्रह्मविष्णुगणांस्तथा ..
इदानीं किं मया कार्यं भवद्भिः शिववर्जितैः .. 196 ..
17.9.m:
Afterwards they undergo perversion; alas, they must be slain by me.
Merely with a leaf, with a flower, with the syllable Oṃ, and with [the name] Śiva,
a man attains liberation, O god; who will perform devotion to Bhava? // 7.2.9.190
The gods headed by Indra are also those whom [mortals] gratify through sacrifices.
Twice-born men do not perform sacrifices; you are pleased by the giving of alms. // 191
Rudra said:
I have no concern with Indra and the others; what will Brahmā do for me?
By whatever means, the subjects must now be protected by you. // 192
This indeed is my nature; how could I bring myself to abandon it?
I was appointed to the duty of granting boons by you, by Brahmā, and by the gods. // 193
Even now, what is lost? Leaving the goddess before you,
having relinquished my form, I wander alone. // 194
Having spoken thus, the god Śiva vanished right there.
When that Śiva had departed, an immense agitation arose there. // 195
And Umā said to the gods headed by Indra, and likewise to the hosts of Brahmā and Viṣṇu:
'What must now be done by me with you who are bereft of Śiva?' // 196

17.9.s:
atrāntare ca ye cānye devāstatra samāgatāḥ ..
ṛṣayaścaiva siddhāśca tathā nāradaparvatau .. 197 ..
gaṃgāsarasvatīnadyo nāgā yakṣāḥ samāgatāḥ ..
brahmādibhiḥ samālocya kathametadbhaviṣyati .. 198 ..
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
sahaiva gamyatāṃ tatra yatra devo gataḥ śivaḥ ..
svalpā yāsena te yāntu narāḥ svargaṃ śivājñayā .. 199 ..
satyaloke narā yāntu devā yāntu dharātalam ..
rakṣodānavadaityānāṃ varānyacchatu śaṃkaraḥ .. 7.2.9.200 ..
teṣāṃ bādhā mayā kāryā yai ca syurdharmalopakāḥ ..
hṛṣṭe śive mayā kāryā vyavasthā svargagāminām .. .. 201 ..
trayīdharmaṃ parityajya ye'nyaṃ dharmamupāsate ..
te narā narakaṃ yāṃtu yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 202 ..
yadā'dṛśyaḥ śivo jātaḥ pravi veśa girervanam ..
girīṇāṃ madhyamāsthāya tyaktvā divye sa vāsasī .. 203 ..
17.9.d:
अत्रान्तरे च ये चान्ये देवास्तत्र समागताः ..
ऋषयश्चैव सिद्धाश्च तथा नारदपर्वतौ .. 197 ..
गंगासरस्वतीनद्यो नागा यक्षाः समागताः ..
ब्रह्मादिभिः समालोच्य कथमेतद्भविष्यति .. 198 ..
.. विष्णुरुवाच .. ..
सहैव गम्यतां तत्र यत्र देवो गतः शिवः ..
स्वल्पा यासेन ते यान्तु नराः स्वर्गं शिवाज्ञया .. 199 ..
सत्यलोके नरा यान्तु देवा यान्तु धरातलम् ..
रक्षोदानवदैत्यानां वरान्यच्छतु शंकरः .. 7.2.9.200 ..
तेषां बाधा मया कार्या यै च स्युर्धर्मलोपकाः ..
हृष्टे शिवे मया कार्या व्यवस्था स्वर्गगामिनाम् .. .. 201 ..
त्रयीधर्मं परित्यज्य येऽन्यं धर्ममुपासते ..
ते नरा नरकं यांतु यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् .. 202 ..
यदाऽदृश्यः शिवो जातः प्रवि वेश गिरेर्वनम् ..
गिरीणां मध्यमास्थाय त्यक्त्वा दिव्ये स वाससी .. 203 ..
17.9.m:
Meanwhile, the other gods also arrived there,
as well as seers and perfected ones, and likewise Nārada and Parvata. // 197
The rivers Gaṅgā and Sarasvatī, the nāgas, and the yakṣas assembled,
deliberating with Brahmā and the others: 'How will this come to pass?' // 198
Viṣṇu said:
Let us go together right there where the god Śiva has gone.
With little effort, let those men go to heaven by the command of Śiva. // 199
Let men go to Satyaloka; let the gods go to the surface of the earth.
Let Śaṃkara bestow boons upon rakṣases, dānavas, and daityas. // 7.2.9.200
They must be impeded by me, whoever should be destroyers of dharma.
When Śiva is pleased, the arrangement for those going to heaven must be made by me. // 201
Those who, abandoning the dharma of the three Vedas, practice another dharma—
let those men go to hell until the dissolution of beings. // 202
When Śiva became invisible, he entered the forest of the mountain.
Resorting to the middle of the mountains, having cast off his two divine garments, // 203

17.9.s:
gajājinaṃ parityajya tyaktvā mūrttiṃ maheśvaraḥ ..
bhittvā bhūmitalaṃ devaḥ sthāṇurūpo babhūva saḥ .. 204 ..
yasmātsvaṃyabhūrbhavati bhavaṃstasmātsvayaṃ haraḥ ..
atrāṃtare surāḥ sarve na paśyaṃti maheśvaram ..
jñānātītaṃ kalātītaṃ divyadhyānabahiḥ sthitam .. 205 ..
yadā devā vyākulāḥ saṃpataṃti ravirvāyuraṃbaraṃ toyamurvī ..
nije sthāne varttamānā umāyāḥ śaśaṃsurvai devadevaṃ surāṇām .. 206 ..
svarge dharitryāṃ caritaṃ taleṣu deveṣu martyeṣu sarīsṛpeṣu ..
sthūleṣu sūkṣmeṣu yathā tathaiva satyaṃ hi vācyaṃ padamasmadīyam .. 207 ..
tato devāḥ pracalitāḥ kṛtvā gaurīṃ purassaram ..
naṃdi bhadrādayaḥ sarve devā iṃdrādayastathā .. 208 ..
skandena sahitā devī siṃhārūḍhā yayau svayam ..
adhiruhya garutmaṃtaṃ yayau viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ .. 209 ..
17.9.d:
गजाजिनं परित्यज्य त्यक्त्वा मूर्त्तिं महेश्वरः ..
भित्त्वा भूमितलं देवः स्थाणुरूपो बभूव सः .. 204 ..
यस्मात्स्वंयभूर्भवति भवंस्तस्मात्स्वयं हरः ..
अत्रांतरे सुराः सर्वे न पश्यंति महेश्वरम् ..
ज्ञानातीतं कलातीतं दिव्यध्यानबहिः स्थितम् .. 205 ..
यदा देवा व्याकुलाः संपतंति रविर्वायुरंबरं तोयमुर्वी ..
निजे स्थाने वर्त्तमाना उमायाः शशंसुर्वै देवदेवं सुराणाम् .. 206 ..
स्वर्गे धरित्र्यां चरितं तलेषु देवेषु मर्त्येषु सरीसृपेषु ..
स्थूलेषु सूक्ष्मेषु यथा तथैव सत्यं हि वाच्यं पदमस्मदीयम् .. 207 ..
ततो देवाः प्रचलिताः कृत्वा गौरीं पुरस्सरम् ..
नंदि भद्रादयः सर्वे देवा इंद्रादयस्तथा .. 208 ..
स्कन्देन सहिता देवी सिंहारूढा ययौ स्वयम् ..
अधिरुह्य गरुत्मंतं ययौ विष्णुः सनातनः .. 209 ..
17.9.m:
having abandoned the elephant-hide, having cast off his form, Maheśvara,
the god, having split the surface of the earth, assumed the form of a pillar. // 204
Since, being Bhava, he is self-manifest, Hara is therefore self-manifest.
Meanwhile, all the gods did not see Maheśvara,
who is beyond knowledge, beyond subtle parts, standing outside divine contemplation. // 205
When the gods rushed about in confusion, the sun, wind, sky, water, and earth,
remaining in their own places, praised the god of gods to the gods of Umā: // 206
'His deed is in heaven, on earth, in the nether regions, among gods, mortals, and reptiles,
among gross and subtle things alike; indeed, our true abode must be spoken.' // 207
Then the gods set out, placing Gaurī in front—
all [the attendants], Nandin, Bhadra, and others, and likewise the gods headed by Indra. // 208
Accompanied by Skanda, the goddess mounted a lion and went herself;
having mounted Garuḍa, the eternal Viṣṇu went. // 209

17.9.s:
haṃsādhirūḍho bhagavānbrahmā yāti sa pṛṣṭhataḥ ..
airāvataṃ samāruhya devarājo'gamatsvayam .. .. 7.2.9.210 ..
gaṃgā sarasvatī devī yamunā ca mahānadī ..
devatāśca gatāḥ sarve nāgā yakṣāḥ sakiṃnarāḥ .. 211 ..
gatāḥ saṃkṣepataḥ sarve yatra devo maheśvaraḥ ..
adhiruhya gireḥ śṛṃgamaṃbā devī vyavasthitā .. 212 ..
viṣṇurmuktvā garutmaṃtaṃ sthito raivatake girau ..
stutiṃ cakre tadā devī jagurgītaṃ susaṃyatāḥ .. 213 ..
airāvatapadākrāṃto na cacāla sa parvataḥ ..
bhittvā bhūmitalaṃ tatra nāgarājaḥ samāgataḥ .. 214 ..
gaṃgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāstena raṃdhreṇa cāgatāḥ ..
brahmā viṣṇuryadā devāḥ stutiṃ cakruḥ samaṃtataḥ .. 215 ..
dadarśa rūpaṃ bhagavānbhavo devastadā haraḥ .. 216 ..
tato hṛṣṭāḥ surāḥ sarve aṃbā hṛṣṭā gaṇāśca te ..
gamyatāṃ deva kailāsaṃ devyeti saṃpramoditaḥ .. 217 ..
17.9.d:
हंसाधिरूढो भगवान्ब्रह्मा याति स पृष्ठतः ..
ऐरावतं समारुह्य देवराजोऽगमत्स्वयम् .. .. 7.2.9.210 ..
गंगा सरस्वती देवी यमुना च महानदी ..
देवताश्च गताः सर्वे नागा यक्षाः सकिंनराः .. 211 ..
गताः संक्षेपतः सर्वे यत्र देवो महेश्वरः ..
अधिरुह्य गिरेः शृंगमंबा देवी व्यवस्थिता .. 212 ..
विष्णुर्मुक्त्वा गरुत्मंतं स्थितो रैवतके गिरौ ..
स्तुतिं चक्रे तदा देवी जगुर्गीतं सुसंयताः .. 213 ..
ऐरावतपदाक्रांतो न चचाल स पर्वतः ..
भित्त्वा भूमितलं तत्र नागराजः समागतः .. 214 ..
गंगाद्याः सरितः सर्वास्तेन रंध्रेण चागताः ..
ब्रह्मा विष्णुर्यदा देवाः स्तुतिं चक्रुः समंततः .. 215 ..
ददर्श रूपं भगवान्भवो देवस्तदा हरः .. 216 ..
ततो हृष्टाः सुराः सर्वे अंबा हृष्टा गणाश्च ते ..
गम्यतां देव कैलासं देव्येति संप्रमोदितः .. 217 ..
17.9.m:
Mounted upon a swan, the blessed Brahmā followed behind;
having mounted Airāvata, the king of gods went himself. // 7.2.9.210
The Gaṅgā, the goddess Sarasvatī, and the great river Yamunā,
and all the deities went, along with nāgas, yakṣas, and kinnaras. // 211
In short, everyone went to where the god Maheśvara was.
Ascending the peak of the mountain, the goddess Ambā took her stand. // 212
Viṣṇu, dismounting from Garuḍa, stood on the Raivataka mountain.
Then the goddess praised him, and the well-restrained ones sang a song. // 213
Trod upon by the feet of Airāvata, that mountain did not waver.
Splitting the surface of the earth, the king of the nāgas arrived there. // 214
All the rivers headed by the Gaṅgā also came through that opening.
When the gods, Brahmā and Viṣṇu, praised him all around, // 215
the blessed Lord Bhava, the god Hara, then revealed his form. // 216
Then all the gods were delighted, Ambā was delighted, and those attendants too;
'O god, go to Kailāsa with the goddess,' he was thus delighted. // 217

17.9.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
yadi hṛṣṭāḥ surāḥ sarve gaṃgādyāḥ saritastathā ..
girau raivatake viṣṇuraṃbā cātraiva tiṣṭhatu ..218..
sarasvatī ca yamunā revā cāsminvyavasthitāḥ ..
svarṇarūpaṃ jalaṃ yasmātsvarṇarekheti sā nadī .. 219 ..
vastrāpathamidaṃ kṣetraṃ bhavo devo'tra tiṣṭhatu ..
tīrthametanmayā proktaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam ..
atra snāto naro nārī mucyate sarva pātakaiḥ ..7.2.9.220..
iti procya śivo devaḥ kalāṃ nyasya bhave tadā ..
paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ yayau kailāsaparvatam .. 221 ..
aṃbeti skandavadanātkalāṃ nyasya girau tadā ..
devena sahitā devī vṛṣārūḍhā yayau svayam .. 222 ..
nārāyaṇo raivatake girau ramye sthitaḥ svayam ..
kalpādau ca yugādau ca sthito viṣṇuḥ sadā girau .. 223 ..
bahurātrasthito devaḥ kṛtvā daityanibarhaṇam ..
reme raivatake devo yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 224 ..
17.9.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
यदि हृष्टाः सुराः सर्वे गंगाद्याः सरितस्तथा ..
गिरौ रैवतके विष्णुरंबा चात्रैव तिष्ठतु ..218..
सरस्वती च यमुना रेवा चास्मिन्व्यवस्थिताः ..
स्वर्णरूपं जलं यस्मात्स्वर्णरेखेति सा नदी .. 219 ..
वस्त्रापथमिदं क्षेत्रं भवो देवोऽत्र तिष्ठतु ..
तीर्थमेतन्मया प्रोक्तं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकम् ..
अत्र स्नातो नरो नारी मुच्यते सर्व पातकैः ..7.2.9.220..
इति प्रोच्य शिवो देवः कलां न्यस्य भवे तदा ..
पश्यतां सर्वदेवानां ययौ कैलासपर्वतम् .. 221 ..
अंबेति स्कन्दवदनात्कलां न्यस्य गिरौ तदा ..
देवेन सहिता देवी वृषारूढा ययौ स्वयम् .. 222 ..
नारायणो रैवतके गिरौ रम्ये स्थितः स्वयम् ..
कल्पादौ च युगादौ च स्थितो विष्णुः सदा गिरौ .. 223 ..
बहुरात्रस्थितो देवः कृत्वा दैत्यनिबर्हणम् ..
रेमे रैवतके देवो यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् .. 224 ..
17.9.m:
Īśvara said:
'If all the gods are delighted, and likewise the rivers headed by the Gaṅgā,
let Viṣṇu remain on the Raivataka mountain, and Ambā right here. // 218
And the Sarasvatī, the Yamunā, and the Revā remain in this place.
Because its water has the appearance of gold, that river is the Suvarṇarekhā. // 219
This is the sacred field Vastrāpatha; let the god Bhava remain here.
This sacred ford, granting worldly enjoyment and liberation, has been proclaimed by me;
bathed here, a man or woman is freed from all sins.' // 7.2.9.220
Having spoken thus, the god Śiva, depositing a portion of himself in Bhava,
went to Mount Kailāsa while all the gods were looking on. // 221
Addressed as 'Ambā' by Skanda, having deposited a portion on the mountain,
the goddess herself, mounted upon the bull, went along with the god. // 222
Nārāyaṇa himself stayed on the delightful Mount Raivataka; / Viṣṇu remains always on the mountain at the beginning of a kalpa and at the beginning of a yuga. 223 .
Having remained for many nights, and having destroyed the Daityas, / the god delighted on Mount Raivataka until the dissolution of all beings. 224 .

17.9.s:
nārasiṃhena rūpeṇa hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ ..
hatvā tadā gatastatra nārasiṃhaṃ mumoca ha .. 225 ..
mahāvarāharūpeṇa hiraṇyākṣo nipātitaḥ ..
tadeva muktvā deveśaḥ sthito raivatake girau .. 226 ..
sa pṛthuṃ pārthivaṃ kṛtvā devakāryeṇa vai nṛpa ..
girau raivatake deva uvāsa surapūjitaḥ .. 227 ..
atrāgatya pṛthuḥ pūrvaṃ cakre devaprapūjanam ..
japamālā tadā kaṇṭhe pṛthunā saṃniveśitā ..
dāmodareti deveśanāma cakre pṛthuḥ svayam .. 228 ..
vastrāpathe devavaro bhavaḥ sthito dāmodaro raivatake vyavasthitaḥ ..
aṃbetidevī girimūrdhni saṃsthitā devāśca sarve paritaḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ .. 229 ..
kṣetrādhipāstīrthavarasya rakṣakā devena muktā bhavasaṃnidhānataḥ ..
paśyaṃti ye devavaraṃ bhavābhidhaṃ mucyaṃti te yāṃti divaṃ narā bhuvaḥ .. 7.2.9.230 ..
17.9.d:
नारसिंहेन रूपेण हिरण्यकशिपुर्हतः ..
हत्वा तदा गतस्तत्र नारसिंहं मुमोच ह .. 225 ..
महावराहरूपेण हिरण्याक्षो निपातितः ..
तदेव मुक्त्वा देवेशः स्थितो रैवतके गिरौ .. 226 ..
स पृथुं पार्थिवं कृत्वा देवकार्येण वै नृप ..
गिरौ रैवतके देव उवास सुरपूजितः .. 227 ..
अत्रागत्य पृथुः पूर्वं चक्रे देवप्रपूजनम् ..
जपमाला तदा कण्ठे पृथुना संनिवेशिता ..
दामोदरेति देवेशनाम चक्रे पृथुः स्वयम् .. 228 ..
वस्त्रापथे देववरो भवः स्थितो दामोदरो रैवतके व्यवस्थितः ..
अंबेतिदेवी गिरिमूर्ध्नि संस्थिता देवाश्च सर्वे परितः प्रतिष्ठिताः .. 229 ..
क्षेत्राधिपास्तीर्थवरस्य रक्षका देवेन मुक्ता भवसंनिधानतः ..
पश्यंति ये देववरं भवाभिधं मुच्यंति ते यांति दिवं नरा भुवः .. 7.2.9.230 ..
17.9.m:
Hiraṇyakaśipu was slain by him in the form of Narasiṃha; / having slain him, he went there and discarded the form of Narasiṃha. 225 .
Hiraṇyākṣa was struck down by him in the form of the Great Boar; / discarding that very form, the lord of gods stayed on Mount Raivataka. 226 .
Having made Pṛthu king for the sake of the gods' mission, O king, / the god, worshipped by the gods, dwelt on Mount Raivataka. 227 .
Coming here in ancient times, Pṛthu performed the worship of the god; / a rosary was then placed around his neck by Pṛthu, / and Pṛthu himself gave the lord of gods the name Dāmodara. 228 .
In Vastrāpatha stands Bhava, the foremost of gods, and Dāmodara is stationed on Mount Raivataka; / the goddess Ambā resides on the mountain summit, and all the gods are established all around. 229 .
The guardians of the sacred field, protectors of the excellent sacred ford, were released by the god through proximity to Bhava; / mortals of the earth who behold the foremost god called Bhava are liberated and go to heaven. 230 .

17.9.s:
vastrāpathasya kṣetrasya bhavasya ca mayā tava ..
utpattiḥ kathitā rājankimanyacchrotumicchasi .. 231 ..
śṛṇoti paṭhate yaśca kathāṃ cemāṃ samaṃtataḥ ..
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ svargaloke mahīyate .. 232 ..
brahmaghnaśca surāpaśca bhrūṇahā gurutalpagaḥ ..
svarṇarekhājale snāto mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 233 ..
ye ca kīṭapataṃgādyāḥ svarṇarekhā jale mṛtāḥ ..
sarvapātakanirmuktāste prayāṃti surālayam .. 134 ..
svarṇarekhājale snātvā saṃdhyāṃ śrāddhaṃ karoti yaḥ ..
vastrāpathe bhavaṃ pūjya brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati .. 235 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye bhavotpattivṛttāṃta varṇanaṃnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 9 ..
17.9.d:
वस्त्रापथस्य क्षेत्रस्य भवस्य च मया तव ..
उत्पत्तिः कथिता राजन्किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छसि .. 231 ..
शृणोति पठते यश्च कथां चेमां समंततः ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः स्वर्गलोके महीयते .. 232 ..
ब्रह्मघ्नश्च सुरापश्च भ्रूणहा गुरुतल्पगः ..
स्वर्णरेखाजले स्नातो मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 233 ..
ये च कीटपतंगाद्याः स्वर्णरेखा जले मृताः ..
सर्वपातकनिर्मुक्तास्ते प्रयांति सुरालयम् .. 134 ..
स्वर्णरेखाजले स्नात्वा संध्यां श्राद्धं करोति यः ..
वस्त्रापथे भवं पूज्य ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति .. 235 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे वस्त्रापथक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये भवोत्पत्तिवृत्तांत वर्णनंनाम नवमोऽध्यायः .. 9 ..
17.9.m:
The origin of the sacred field Vastrāpatha and of Bhava has thus been told by me to you, / O king; what else do you wish to hear? 231 .
Whoever listens to or recites this narrative entirely / is freed from all sins and is exalted in the world of heaven. 232 .
Even a killer of a brahmin, a drinker of liquor, a slayer of an embryo, and a violator of his guru's bed, / when bathed in the water of the Svarṇarekhā, is freed from all sins. 233 .
And whatever worms, winged insects, and the like die in the water of the Svarṇarekhā, / freed from all sins, they proceed to the abode of the gods. 234 .
Having bathed in the water of the Svarṇarekhā, whoever performs twilight prayers and the ancestral rite, / and worships Bhava in Vastrāpatha, goes to the world of Brahmā. 235 .
Thus ends the ninth chapter, titled “Description of the Origin of Bhava,” in the Vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmya of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh part of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skandapurāṇa. 9 .

17.10.s:
.. pārvatyuvāca .. ..
aho tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ gire raivatakasya ca ..
bhavasya devadevasya tathā vastrāpathasya ca .. 1 ..
17.10.d:
.. पार्वत्युवाच .. ..
अहो तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं गिरे रैवतकस्य च ..
भवस्य देवदेवस्य तथा वस्त्रापथस्य च .. 1 ..
17.10.m: Pārvatī said: / Ah, the greatness of the sacred ford and of Mount Raivataka, / of Bhava, the god of gods, and likewise of Vastrāpatha! 1 .

17.10.s:
gaṃgā sarasvatī caiva gomatī narmadā nadī ..
svarṇarekhājale sarvāstathā brahmā savāsavaḥ .. 2 ..
17.10.d:
गंगा सरस्वती चैव गोमती नर्मदा नदी ..
स्वर्णरेखाजले सर्वास्तथा ब्रह्मा सवासवः .. 2 ..
17.10.m: The Gaṅgā, the Sarasvatī, the Gomatī, and the river Narmadā / all reside in the water of the Svarṇarekhā, as well as Brahmā with Indra. 2 .

17.10.s:
brahmendra viṣṇumukhyānāṃ devānāṃ śaṃkarasya ca ..
vāso viracitastatra yāvadbrahmadinaṃ bhavet .. 3 ..
17.10.d:
ब्रह्मेन्द्र विष्णुमुख्यानां देवानां शंकरस्य च ..
वासो विरचितस्तत्र यावद्ब्रह्मदिनं भवेत् .. 3 ..
17.10.m: An abode of the gods headed by Brahmā, Indra, and Viṣṇu, and of Śaṃkara, / has been established there for as long as a day of Brahmā lasts. 3 .

17.10.s:
kṣetratīrthaprabhāvaṃ ca prasādāttava śaṃkara ..
śrutaṃ savistaraṃ sarvamidaṃ tvaduditaṃ mayā .. 4 ..
17.10.d:
क्षेत्रतीर्थप्रभावं च प्रसादात्तव शंकर ..
श्रुतं सविस्तरं सर्वमिदं त्वदुदितं मया .. 4 ..
17.10.m: And the power of the sacred field and the sacred ford, by your grace, O Śaṃkara, / all this uttered by you has been heard by me in detail. 4 .

17.10.s:
maheśvara prabho brūhi kiṃ cakāra janeśvaraḥ ..
bhojarājo mṛgīṃ prāpya sa ca sārasvato muniḥ .. 5 .. ..
17.10.d:
महेश्वर प्रभो ब्रूहि किं चकार जनेश्वरः ..
भोजराजो मृगीं प्राप्य स च सारस्वतो मुनिः .. 5 .. ..
17.10.m: O Maheśvara, O Lord, tell me what the ruler of men, / King Bhoja, did having obtained the doe, and [what did] that sage Sārasvata? 5 .

17.10.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tāsu sarvāsu nārīṣu rūpaudāryaguṇādhikā ..
nityaṃ pramuditā śāṃtā nityaṃ maṃgalakārikā .. 6 ..
17.10.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तासु सर्वासु नारीषु रूपौदार्यगुणाधिका ..
नित्यं प्रमुदिता शांता नित्यं मंगलकारिका .. 6 ..
17.10.m: Īśvara said: / Among all those women, she surpassed them in beauty, generosity, and virtues; / she was ever joyful, peaceful, and ever doing what was auspicious. 6 .

17.10.s:
mātā svasā sakhī putrī strīṣu saṃbandhavardhanī ..
pitā bhrātā guruḥ putraḥ puruṣeṣu tathā kṛtaḥ .. 7 ..
17.10.d:
माता स्वसा सखी पुत्री स्त्रीषु संबन्धवर्धनी ..
पिता भ्राता गुरुः पुत्रः पुरुषेषु तथा कृतः .. 7 ..
17.10.m: A mother, sister, companion, and daughter, she strengthened bonds among the women; / a father, brother, guru, and son, so was [each] treated among the men. 7 .

17.10.s:
evaṃ guṇavatīṃ bhāryāṃ prāpya hṛṣṭo janeśvaraḥ ..
sārasvataṃ muniṃ stutvā rājā vacanamabravīt .. 8 ..
17.10.d:
एवं गुणवतीं भार्यां प्राप्य हृष्टो जनेश्वरः ..
सारस्वतं मुनिं स्तुत्वा राजा वचनमब्रवीत् .. 8 ..
17.10.m: Having obtained such a virtuous wife, the ruler of men was delighted; / having praised the sage Sārasvata, the king spoke these words: 8 .

17.10.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
brahmā viṣṇurharaḥ sūrya indro'gnirmarutāṃ gaṇaḥ ..
brahmacaryeṇa tapasā tvayā santoṣitāḥ prabho .. 9 ..
17.10.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
ब्रह्मा विष्णुर्हरः सूर्य इन्द्रोऽग्निर्मरुतां गणः ..
ब्रह्मचर्येण तपसा त्वया सन्तोषिताः प्रभो .. 9 ..
17.10.m: The king said: / Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Hara, Sūrya, Indra, Agni, and the host of Maruts / have been pleased by you through celibacy and austerity, O lord. 9 .

17.10.s:
daivataṃ paramaṃ me tvaṃ pitā mātā guruḥ prabhuḥ ..
yena janmāṃtaraṃ sarvaṃ pratyakṣaṃ kathitaṃ mama .. 7.2.10.10 ..
17.10.d:
दैवतं परमं मे त्वं पिता माता गुरुः प्रभुः ..
येन जन्मांतरं सर्वं प्रत्यक्षं कथितं मम .. 7.2.10.10 ..
17.10.m: You are my supreme deity, father, mother, guru, and lord, / by whom all about my other birth has been told visibly to me. 10 .

17.10.s:
surāṣṭradeśo vikhyāto girī raivatako mahān ..
bhavaḥ svayaṃbhūrbhagavānkṣetre vastrāpathe śrutaḥ .. 11 ..
17.10.d:
सुराष्ट्रदेशो विख्यातो गिरी रैवतको महान् ..
भवः स्वयंभूर्भगवान्क्षेत्रे वस्त्रापथे श्रुतः .. 11 ..
17.10.m: The land of Surāṣṭra is renowned, and great is Mount Raivataka; / the self-manifest Lord Bhava is renowned in the sacred field Vastrāpatha. 11 .

17.10.s:
ujjayaṃtagirermūrdhni gaurīskandagaṇeśvarāḥ ..
bhāvayaṃto bhavaṃ sarve saṃsthitā brahmavāsaram .. 12 ..
17.10.d:
उज्जयंतगिरेर्मूर्ध्नि गौरीस्कन्दगणेश्वराः ..
भावयंतो भवं सर्वे संस्थिता ब्रह्मवासरम् .. 12 ..
17.10.m: On the summit of Mount Ujjayanta, Gaurī, Skanda, and the lords of the Gaṇas, / contemplating Bhava, all remain stationed for a day of Brahmā. 12 .

17.10.s:
vāmano nagaraṃ sthāpya śivaṃ siddheśvaraṃ prati ..
jitvā daityaṃ baliṃ baddhvā svayaṃ raivatake sthitaḥ .. 13 ..
17.10.d:
वामनो नगरं स्थाप्य शिवं सिद्धेश्वरं प्रति ..
जित्वा दैत्यं बलिं बद्ध्वा स्वयं रैवतके स्थितः .. 13 ..
17.10.m: Vāmana, having founded a city facing Śiva Siddheśvara, / having conquered and bound the Daitya Bali, himself stayed on Mount Raivataka. 13 .

17.10.s:
ityetatsarvamāścaryaṃ jīvadbhiryadi dṛśyate ..
tīrthayātrāvidhānena bhavo vastrāpathe hariḥ .. 14 ..
17.10.d:
इत्येतत्सर्वमाश्चर्यं जीवद्भिर्यदि दृश्यते ..
तीर्थयात्राविधानेन भवो वस्त्रापथे हरिः .. 14 ..
17.10.m: If all this wonder can be seen by living beings— / Bhava and Hari in Vastrāpatha by means of the rule of pilgrimage to sacred fords— 14 .

17.10.s:
tyaktvā rājyaṃ priyānputrānpattyaśvarathakuñjarān ..
putraṃ rājye pratiṣṭhāpya gantavyaṃ niścitaṃ mayā .. 15 ..
17.10.d:
त्यक्त्वा राज्यं प्रियान्पुत्रान्पत्त्यश्वरथकुञ्जरान् ..
पुत्रं राज्ये प्रतिष्ठाप्य गन्तव्यं निश्चितं मया .. 15 ..
17.10.m: then having abandoned my kingdom, beloved sons, infantry, horses, chariots, and elephants, / and having installed my son in the kingship, I must surely go. 15 .

17.10.s:
tvatprasādācchrutaṃ sarvaṃ gamyate yadi dṛśyate ..
tīrthayātrāvidhānena bhavo vastrāpathe hariḥ .. 16 ..
17.10.d:
त्वत्प्रसादाच्छ्रुतं सर्वं गम्यते यदि दृश्यते ..
तीर्थयात्राविधानेन भवो वस्त्रापथे हरिः .. 16 ..
17.10.m: By your favor all has been heard; it should be visited if it can be seen— / Bhava and Hari in Vastrāpatha by means of the rule of pilgrimage to sacred fords. 16 .

17.10.s:
sūryalokaṃ somalokamiṃdralokaṃ hareḥ puram ..
brahmalokamatikramya yāsye'haṃ śivamaṃdiram .. 17 ..
17.10.d:
सूर्यलोकं सोमलोकमिंद्रलोकं हरेः पुरम् ..
ब्रह्मलोकमतिक्रम्य यास्येऽहं शिवमंदिरम् .. 17 ..
17.10.m: Having passed beyond the world of Sūrya, the world of Soma, the world of Indra, the city of Hari, / and the world of Brahmā, I shall go to the abode of Śiva. 17 .

17.10.s:
śrutvā hi vākyaṃ vividhaṃ narendrātprahṛṣṭaromā sa munirbabhūva ..
jijñāsamāno hi nṛpasya sarvaṃ nivārayāmāsa munirnarendram .. 18 ..
17.10.d:
श्रुत्वा हि वाक्यं विविधं नरेन्द्रात्प्रहृष्टरोमा स मुनिर्बभूव ..
जिज्ञासमानो हि नृपस्य सर्वं निवारयामास मुनिर्नरेन्द्रम् .. 18 ..
17.10.m: Hearing these manifold words from the lord of men, the sage had his hair stand on end; / wishing to test everything about the king, the sage dissuaded the lord of men. 18 .

17.10.s:
.. sārasvata uvāca .. ..
gṛhe'pi devā haraviṣṇumukhyā jalāni darbhā nṛpate tilāśca ..
anekadeśāṃtaradarśanārthaṃ mano nivāryaṃ nṛpate tvayeti .. 19 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye vastrāpatha kṣetrayātrotsukasya bhojabhūpasya sārasvatamunikṛtopadeśavarṇanaṃnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 10 ..
17.10.d:
.. सारस्वत उवाच .. ..
गृहेऽपि देवा हरविष्णुमुख्या जलानि दर्भा नृपते तिलाश्च ..
अनेकदेशांतरदर्शनार्थं मनो निवार्यं नृपते त्वयेति .. 19 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे द्वितीये वस्त्रापथक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये वस्त्रापथ क्षेत्रयात्रोत्सुकस्य भोजभूपस्य सारस्वतमुनिकृतोपदेशवर्णनंनाम दशमोऽध्यायः .. 10 ..
17.10.m:
Sārasvata said: / Even in one's own house are the gods headed by Hara and Viṣṇu, waters, darbha-grass, and sesame seeds, O king; / your mind should be turned back, O king, from the desire to see various other lands. 19 .
Thus ends the tenth chapter, titled “Description of the Instruction Given by the Sage Sārasvata to King Bhoja Who Was Eager to Make a Pilgrimage to the Sacred Field Vastrāpatha,” in the second [sub-section], the Vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmya, of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh part of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skandapurāṇa. 10 .

17.11.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
sārasvatasya viprasya śrutvā bhojanṛpo vacaḥ ..
vivarṇavadano bhūtvā pragṛhyāṃghrī vaco'bravīt .. 1 ..
17.11.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
सारस्वतस्य विप्रस्य श्रुत्वा भोजनृपो वचः ..
विवर्णवदनो भूत्वा प्रगृह्यांघ्री वचोऽब्रवीत् .. 1 ..
17.11.m: Īśvara said: / Hearing the words of the brahmin Sārasvata, King Bhoja, / his face losing its color, grasped his feet and spoke these words: 1 .

17.11.s:
mune naivaṃ tvayā vācyaṃ gaṃtavyaṃ niścitaṃ mayā ..
narāṇāṃ puṇyadā yātrā kathayasva kathaṃ bhavet .. 2 ..
17.11.d:
मुने नैवं त्वया वाच्यं गंतव्यं निश्चितं मया ..
नराणां पुण्यदा यात्रा कथयस्व कथं भवेत् .. 2 ..
17.11.m: O sage, you must not speak like this; I have resolved that I must go. / Tell me how the pilgrimage that grants merit to mortals is performed. 2 .

17.11.s:
kiṃ grāhyaṃ kiṃ ca moktavyaṃ kiṃ deyaṃ kiṃ na dīyate ..
tīrthopavāsaḥ snānaṃ ca saṃdhyāsnānavidhikramaḥ ..
pūjā nidrā japo rātrau sarvaṃ saṃkṣepato vada .. 3 ..
17.11.d:
किं ग्राह्यं किं च मोक्तव्यं किं देयं किं न दीयते ..
तीर्थोपवासः स्नानं च संध्यास्नानविधिक्रमः ..
पूजा निद्रा जपो रात्रौ सर्वं संक्षेपतो वद .. 3 ..
17.11.m: What is to be taken and what is to be discarded? What is to be given and what is not given? / Fasting at the sacred ford, ritual ablution, the proper order for twilight ritual ablutions, / worship, sleeping, and recitation at night—tell me all this in brief. 3 .

17.11.s:
.. sārasvata uvāca .. ..
surāṣṭradeśe gantavyaṃ girau raivatake yadi ..
nṛpa yātrāvidhiṃ vakṣye tvamekāgramanāḥ śṛṇu .. .. 4 ..
17.11.d:
.. सारस्वत उवाच .. ..
सुराष्ट्रदेशे गन्तव्यं गिरौ रैवतके यदि ..
नृप यात्राविधिं वक्ष्ये त्वमेकाग्रमनाः शृणु .. .. 4 ..
17.11.m: Sārasvata said: / If you must go to the land of Surāṣṭra and to Mount Raivataka, / O king, I shall declare the rules of pilgrimage; listen with a focused mind. 4 .

17.11.s:
bṛhaspatibalaṃ gṛhya sūryaṃ saṃtarpya cottamam ..
vāmataḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ sarvaṃ vṛtvā saṃśodhya vāsaram .. 5 ..
17.11.d:
बृहस्पतिबलं गृह्य सूर्यं संतर्प्य चोत्तमम् ..
वामतः पृष्ठतः सर्वं वृत्वा संशोध्य वासरम् .. 5 ..
17.11.m: Having obtained the strength of Bṛhaspati, and having properly gratified the sun, / having placed all [auspicious things] to the left and back, and having purified the day; 5

17.11.s:
caṃdralagnaṃ grahājjñātvā baliṣṭhājjanmarāśitaḥ..
śakunaṃ ca śubhaṃ labdhvā prasthātavyaṃ nṛpairnṛpa .. 6 ..
17.11.d:
चंद्रलग्नं ग्रहाज्ज्ञात्वा बलिष्ठाज्जन्मराशितः..
शकुनं च शुभं लब्ध्वा प्रस्थातव्यं नृपैर्नृप .. 6 ..
17.11.m: having determined the lunar ascendant from the planets, and from the strongest birth sign, / and having obtained an auspicious omen, kings should set forth, O king. 6

17.11.s:
tīrthe sadaiva gaṃtavyaṃ sarve māsāśca śobhanāḥ ..
tithayaścottamāḥ sarvāḥ snānadānārcanādiṣu .. 7 ..
17.11.d:
तीर्थे सदैव गंतव्यं सर्वे मासाश्च शोभनाः ..
तिथयश्चोत्तमाः सर्वाः स्नानदानार्चनादिषु .. 7 ..
17.11.m: One may go to a sacred ford at any time; indeed, all months are auspicious, / and all lunar days are excellent for ritual ablution, giving gifts, worship, and the like. 7

17.11.s:
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ māsāṃte pūrṇimādine ..
saṃkrāṃtau grahaṇe kālā ete proktā bhavārcane ..8..
17.11.d:
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां मासांते पूर्णिमादिने ..
संक्रांतौ ग्रहणे काला एते प्रोक्ता भवार्चने ..8..
17.11.m: On the eighth and fourteenth [lunar days], at the month’s end, on the full moon day, / at a solar transit, and during an eclipse—these times are declared [best] for worshipping Bhava. 8

17.11.s:
kailāsaṃ parvataṃ tyaktvā devīṃ devāṃśca saṃgatān..
vaiśākhe paṃcadaśyāṃ tu bhūmiṃ bhittvā bhavo'bhavat .. 9 ..
17.11.d:
कैलासं पर्वतं त्यक्त्वा देवीं देवांश्च संगतान्..
वैशाखे पंचदश्यां तु भूमिं भित्त्वा भवोऽभवत् .. 9 ..
17.11.m: Leaving Mount Kailāsa, the Goddess, and the assembled gods, / Bhava broke through the earth and emerged on the fifteenth [day] of Vaiśākha. 9

17.11.s:
tasminneva dine devī svarṇarekhā nadī talāt ..
paṃthānaṃ vāsukiṃ prāpya sarvapāpapraṇāśanī .. 7.2.11.10 .. .
17.11.d:
तस्मिन्नेव दिने देवी स्वर्णरेखा नदी तलात् ..
पंथानं वासुकिं प्राप्य सर्वपापप्रणाशनी .. 7.2.11.10 .. .
17.11.m: On that very day, the divine river Svarṇarekhā, destroying all sins, / rose from the subterranean realm, having reached the path of Vāsuki. 10

17.11.s:
airāvatapadākrāṃta ujjayanto mahāgiriḥ ..
susrāva toyaṃ bahudhā gajapādodbhavaṃ śuci .. 11 ..
17.11.d:
ऐरावतपदाक्रांत उज्जयन्तो महागिरिः ..
सुस्राव तोयं बहुधा गजपादोद्भवं शुचि .. 11 ..
17.11.m: The great mountain Ujjayanta, trodden by the feet of Airāvata, / poured forth abundant pure water born from the elephant's feet. 11

17.11.s:
devā brahmādayaḥ sarve gaṃgādyāḥ saritastathā ..
vastrāpathe mahākṣetre bhavabhāvena saṃgatāḥ .. 12 ..
17.11.d:
देवा ब्रह्मादयः सर्वे गंगाद्याः सरितस्तथा ..
वस्त्रापथे महाक्षेत्रे भवभावेन संगताः .. 12 ..
17.11.m: All the gods, beginning with Brahmā, and likewise the rivers, beginning with the Gaṅgā, / gathered in the great sacred field of Vastrāpatha with devotion to Bhava. 12

17.11.s:
vastrāpathasya kṣetrasya pramāṇaṃ śṛṇu bhūpate ..
harasya tyajato bhūmau patitaṃ vastrabhūṣaṇam .. 13 ..
17.11.d:
वस्त्रापथस्य क्षेत्रस्य प्रमाणं शृणु भूपते ..
हरस्य त्यजतो भूमौ पतितं वस्त्रभूषणम् .. 13 ..
17.11.m: Hear, O king, the extent of the sacred field of Vastrāpatha: / As Hara abandoned his vestment and ornament, it fell upon the earth; 13

17.11.s:
tāvanmātraṃ smṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ devairvastrāpathaṃ kṛtam ..
uttareṇa nadī bhadrā pūrvasyāṃ yojanadvayam .. 14 ..
17.11.d:
तावन्मात्रं स्मृतं क्षेत्रं देवैर्वस्त्रापथं कृतम् ..
उत्तरेण नदी भद्रा पूर्वस्यां योजनद्वयम् .. 14 ..
17.11.m: that extent is recorded as the sacred field, designated Vastrāpatha by the gods. / To the north is the river Bhadrā, and to the east it extends two yojanas; 14

17.11.s:
dakṣiṇena baleḥ sthānamujjayanto nadīmanu ..
aparasyāṃ paraṃ nadyo saṃgamaṃ vāmanātpurāt .. 15 ..
17.11.d:
दक्षिणेन बलेः स्थानमुज्जयन्तो नदीमनु ..
अपरस्यां परं नद्यो संगमं वामनात्पुरात् .. 15 ..
17.11.m: to the south lies the place of Bali, and Ujjayanta along the river; / to the west, beyond the city of Vāmana, is the confluence of the rivers. 15

17.11.s:
etadvastrāpathaṃ kṣetraṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam ..
kṣetrasya vistaro jñeyo yojanānāṃ catuṣṭayam .. 16 ..
17.11.d:
एतद्वस्त्रापथं क्षेत्रं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकम् ..
क्षेत्रस्य विस्तरो ज्ञेयो योजनानां चतुष्टयम् .. 16 ..
17.11.m: This sacred field of Vastrāpatha bestows enjoyment and liberation; / the extent of the sacred field is known to be four yojanas. 16

17.11.s:
vaiśākhapaṃcadaśyāṃ tu bhavo bhāvena bhūpate ..
pūjyate śivaloke tu sthīyate brahmavāsaram .. 17 ..
17.11.d:
वैशाखपंचदश्यां तु भवो भावेन भूपते ..
पूज्यते शिवलोके तु स्थीयते ब्रह्मवासरम् .. 17 ..
17.11.m: On the fifteenth [day] of Vaiśākha, O king, Bhava is worshipped with devotion; / he [who does so] dwells in the world of Śiva for a day of Brahmā. 17

17.11.s:
ato vasaṃte saṃprāpte prayāṇaṃ kuru bhūpate ..
nigṛhya niyamānbhūtvā śuciḥ snāto jitendriyaḥ .. 18 ..
17.11.d:
अतो वसंते संप्राप्ते प्रयाणं कुरु भूपते ..
निगृह्य नियमान्भूत्वा शुचिः स्नातो जितेन्द्रियः .. 18 ..
17.11.m: Therefore, when spring has arrived, make the journey, O king, / observing restraints, pure, bathed, and with senses subdued. 18

17.11.s:
gajavājirathāṃstyaktā padābhyāṃ yāti yo naraḥ ..
puṣpakeṇa vimānena sa yāti śivamaṃdiram .. 19 ..
17.11.d:
गजवाजिरथांस्त्यक्ता पदाभ्यां याति यो नरः ..
पुष्पकेण विमानेन स याति शिवमंदिरम् .. 19 ..
17.11.m: The person who abandons elephants, horses, and chariots, and walks on foot, / goes to the abode of Śiva in the Puṣpaka aerial chariot. 19

17.11.s:
ekabhaktena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca ..
bhikṣāhāreṇa toyena phalāhāreṇa vā yadi .. 7.2.11.20 ..
17.11.d:
एकभक्तेन नक्तेन तथैवायाचितेन च ..
भिक्षाहारेण तोयेन फलाहारेण वा यदि .. 7.2.11.20 ..
17.11.m: [Living] on a single meal, on an evening meal, or on unasked-for food, / or if [living] on food obtained by begging, on water, or on fruits; 20

17.11.s:
upavāsena kṛcchreṇa śākāhāreṇa yāti yaḥ ..
sa yāti sundarīvṛndairvījyamāno gaṇairdivi .. 21 ..
17.11.d:
उपवासेन कृच्छ्रेण शाकाहारेण याति यः ..
स याति सुन्दरीवृन्दैर्वीज्यमानो गणैर्दिवि .. 21 ..
17.11.m: whoever goes fasting, performing kṛcchra penance, or subsisting on vegetables, / he goes to heaven fanned by celestial women and attendants. 21

17.11.s:
malasnānaṃ vinā mārge pādābhyaṃgavivarjitaḥ ..
maladhārī kṣīṇatanuryaṣṭihasto jitendriyaḥ .. 22 ..
17.11.d:
मलस्नानं विना मार्गे पादाभ्यंगविवर्जितः ..
मलधारी क्षीणतनुर्यष्टिहस्तो जितेन्द्रियः .. 22 ..
17.11.m: Without a cleansing bath on the way, devoid of foot-anointment, / bearing dust, his body emaciated, a staff in hand, with senses subdued; 22

17.11.s:
śītātapajalakliṣṭaḥ śivasmaraṇatatparaḥ ..
yadi yāti naro yāti sa bhittvā sūryamaṃḍalam .. 23 ..
17.11.d:
शीतातपजलक्लिष्टः शिवस्मरणतत्परः ..
यदि याति नरो याति स भित्त्वा सूर्यमंडलम् .. 23 ..
17.11.m: afflicted by cold, heat, and rain, devoted to remembering Śiva— / if a man journeys thus, he pierces the solar orb and ascends. 23

17.11.s:
narakasthānapi pitṝnmātṛtaḥ pitṛto nṛpa ..
akṣayaṃ sapta saptaiva nayedevaṃ śivālaye .. 24 ..
17.11.d:
नरकस्थानपि पितॄन्मातृतः पितृतो नृप ..
अक्षयं सप्त सप्तैव नयेदेवं शिवालये .. 24 ..
17.11.m: Even if the ancestors are in hell, O king, / he leads seven on the mother's side and seven on the father's to the imperishable abode of Śiva. 24

17.11.s:
luṇṭhanbhūmau yadā yāti mṛgacarmāvaguṃṭhitaḥ ..
daṇḍapramāṇabhūmervā saṃkhyāṃ kurvannaro yadi .. 25 ..
17.11.d:
लुण्ठन्भूमौ यदा याति मृगचर्मावगुंठितः ..
दण्डप्रमाणभूमेर्वा संख्यां कुर्वन्नरो यदि .. 25 ..
17.11.m: If a man goes rolling on the ground, clad in a deer skin, / or measuring the ground by the length of a staff; 25

17.11.s:
araṇye nirjale sthāne jalāṃtaḥparipīḍitaḥ ..
śaraṇyaṃ śaṃkaraṃ kṛtvā mano niścalamātmanaḥ .. 26 ..
17.11.d:
अरण्ये निर्जले स्थाने जलांतःपरिपीडितः ..
शरण्यं शंकरं कृत्वा मनो निश्चलमात्मनः .. 26 ..
17.11.m: in a forest, in a waterless place, distressed by lack of water, / making Śaṃkara his refuge, with his mind steady; 26

17.11.s:
saptadvīpavatīṃ pṛthvīṃ samudravasanāṃ nṛpa ..
sa labdhvā bahubhiryajñairyajñe dattvā ca medinīm .. 27 ..
17.11.d:
सप्तद्वीपवतीं पृथ्वीं समुद्रवसनां नृप ..
स लब्ध्वा बहुभिर्यज्ञैर्यज्ञे दत्त्वा च मेदिनीम् .. 27 ..
17.11.m: having gained the earth possessing seven continents, girdled by the ocean, O king, / through many sacrifices, and having given away the earth in sacrifice; 27

17.11.s:
saptabhaumavimānastho divyadeho harākṛtiḥ ..
nirīkṣya medinīṃ maṃdaṃ kṛta maṃgalamaṇḍanam .. 28 ..
17.11.d:
सप्तभौमविमानस्थो दिव्यदेहो हराकृतिः ..
निरीक्ष्य मेदिनीं मंदं कृत मंगलमण्डनम् .. 28 ..
17.11.m: seated in a seven-storeyed aerial chariot, possessing a divine body, bearing the form of Hara, / looking down gently upon the earth, adorned with auspicious ornaments; 25

17.11.s:
mṛganetrābhujasparśalagnapīnapayodharaḥ ..
gītavādyavinodena satyalokaṃ vrajennaraḥ .. 29 ..
17.11.d:
मृगनेत्राभुजस्पर्शलग्नपीनपयोधरः ..
गीतवाद्यविनोदेन सत्यलोकं व्रजेन्नरः .. 29 ..
17.11.m: with swollen breasts pressed against him in the embrace of deer-eyed women, / entertained by song and instrumental music, such a man goes to Satyaloka. 29

17.11.s:
vidhāya bhujavegaṃ vā pādau baddhvā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ..
maunena mānuṣo māyāṃ tyaktvā yāti śivālaye .. 7.2.11.30 ..
17.11.d:
विधाय भुजवेगं वा पादौ बद्ध्वा शनैः शनैः ..
मौनेन मानुषो मायां त्यक्त्वा याति शिवालये .. 7.2.11.30 ..
17.11.m: Or walking slowly, pacing out his steps with speed of arms, / in silence, shedding delusion, a human being goes to the abode of Śiva. 30

17.11.s:
brahmaghno vā surāpo vā steyī vā gurutalpagaḥ ..
kṛtaghno mucyate pāpairmṛto muktimavāpnuyāt .. 31 ..
17.11.d:
ब्रह्मघ्नो वा सुरापो वा स्तेयी वा गुरुतल्पगः ..
कृतघ्नो मुच्यते पापैर्मृतो मुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् .. 31 ..
17.11.m: Whether a killer of a brahmin, a drinker of liquor, a thief, or one who violates the teacher’s bed, / or an ungrateful person, he is freed from sins, and dying, he attains liberation. 31

17.11.s:
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ deśaṃ bhrātaraṃ svajanabāṃdhavān ..
grāmaṃ bhūmiṃ gṛhaṃ tyaktvā kṛtvā ceṃdriyasaṃyamam .. 32 ..
17.11.d:
मातरं पितरं देशं भ्रातरं स्वजनबांधवान् ..
ग्रामं भूमिं गृहं त्यक्त्वा कृत्वा चेंद्रियसंयमम् .. 32 ..
17.11.m: Leaving mother, father, country, brothers, kinsmen, and relations, / village, land, and home, and exercising restraint of the senses; 32

17.11.s:
gṛhītvā śivasaṃskāraṃ naro bhrāmyati bhūtale ..
draṣṭuṃ tīrthānyanekāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca .. 33 ..
17.11.d:
गृहीत्वा शिवसंस्कारं नरो भ्राम्यति भूतले ..
द्रष्टुं तीर्थान्यनेकानि पुण्यान्यायतनानि च .. 33 ..
17.11.m: having received the rites of Śiva, a man wanders upon the earth / to see many sacred fords and holy shrines. 33

17.11.s:
kasmiṃstīrthe śubhe sthāne chittvā saṃsārabandhanam ..
abhayāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā śivaśiveti bhāṣakaḥ .. 34 ..
17.11.d:
कस्मिंस्तीर्थे शुभे स्थाने छित्त्वा संसारबन्धनम् ..
अभयां दक्षिणां दत्त्वा शिवशिवेति भाषकः .. 34 ..
17.11.m: At some auspicious sacred ford, cutting the bondage of cyclic existence, / giving the gift of fearlessness, repeatedly uttering 'Śiva, Śiva'; 34

17.11.s:
ekāṃte nirjane sthāne śivasmaraṇatatparaḥ ..
yadi tiṣṭhati taṃ yānti namaskartuṃ narādhipa .. 35 ..
17.11.d:
एकांते निर्जने स्थाने शिवस्मरणतत्परः ..
यदि तिष्ठति तं यान्ति नमस्कर्तुं नराधिप .. 35 ..
17.11.m: if he stays in a secluded, deserted place, devoted to remembering Śiva, / they come to bow to him, O lord of men. 35

17.11.s:
āyāṃti devatāḥ sarve cihnaṃ tasya nirīkṣitum ..
vimānavṛndairnetavyaḥ kadāsau puruṣottamaḥ .. 36 ..
17.11.d:
आयांति देवताः सर्वे चिह्नं तस्य निरीक्षितुम् ..
विमानवृन्दैर्नेतव्यः कदासौ पुरुषोत्तमः .. 36 ..
17.11.m: All the deities come to see his mark, [wondering:] / 'When is this best of men to be borne away in hosts of aerial chariots?' 36

17.11.s:
yadā tu pañcatvamupaiti kāle kalevaraṃ skandhakṛtaṃ naraiśca ..
nirīkṣyamāṇaḥ surasundarībhiḥ sa nīyamāno madavihvalābhiḥ .. 37 ..
17.11.d:
यदा तु पञ्चत्वमुपैति काले कलेवरं स्कन्धकृतं नरैश्च ..
निरीक्ष्यमाणः सुरसुन्दरीभिः स नीयमानो मदविह्वलाभिः .. 37 ..
17.11.m: When in time he meets with death and his body is borne on the shoulders of men, / he is watched by celestial beauties languid with passion as he is carried off. 37

17.11.s:
surendrasūryāgnidhaneśarudraiḥ saṃpūjyamānaḥ śivarūpadhārī ..
surādilokānpravimucya vegācchivālaye tiṣṭhati rudrabhaktaḥ .. 38 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetra māhātmye vastrāpathayātrāvidhānavarṇanaṃnāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 11 ..
17.11.d:
सुरेन्द्रसूर्याग्निधनेशरुद्रैः संपूज्यमानः शिवरूपधारी ..
सुरादिलोकान्प्रविमुच्य वेगाच्छिवालये तिष्ठति रुद्रभक्तः .. 38 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे द्वितीये वस्त्रापथक्षेत्र माहात्म्ये वस्त्रापथयात्राविधानवर्णनंनामैकादशोऽध्यायः .. 11 ..
17.11.m:
Worshipped by the lord of the gods, the Sun, Fire, the Lord of Wealth, and the Rudras, assuming the form of Śiva, / that devotee of Rudra swiftly leaves the worlds of the gods and remains in the abode of Śiva. 38
Thus ends the eleventh chapter, titled 'Description of the Rules for Pilgrimage to Vastrāpatha', in the Vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmya, the second [part] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [book] of the glorious Skandamahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. 11
